harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured chrony on the RHEL 10 cluster so node1 acts as the internal time source and node2 syncs against it. On node1, edited /etc/chrony.conf to keep the public pool as node1's own upstream (so it has a real time reference) while adding `allow 10.100.93.11/32` (node2's IP) and `local stratum 10` as a fallback reference, then opened firewalld's ntp service. On node2, replaced the `pool 2.rhel.pool.ntp.org` directive with `server 10.100.93.10 iburst prefer`, pointing it at node1 exclusively. Verified node2 selects node1 (`^* 10.100.93.10`) as its best/only source and node1 lists node2 as an active NTP client. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and chrony state, issued `systemctl reboot` (ack returned before disconnect), polled until each node reconnected, confirmed changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on both (node1: e625b9a5→4c169d03; node2: 6d37896c→541128bd), and verified chronyd was active with the persisted config and the node1↔node2 sync relationship fully recovered after each restart (node2 tracking node1 via Reference ID 0A645D0A; node1 listing node2 as client) before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/chrony baseline on node1 and node2 (RHEL 10, chrony-4.6.1, both using public 2.rhel.pool.ntp.org pool)
Captured pre-change chronyc sources/tracking baselines on both nodes
Edited node1 /etc/chrony.conf: kept public pool as upstream, added 'allow 10.100.93.11/32' and 'local stratum 10' to serve node2 and provide fallback reference
Opened firewalld ntp service on node1 (firewall-cmd --permanent --add-service=ntp --reload)
Restarted chronyd on node1 and verified active
Edited node2 /etc/chrony.conf: removed public pool directive, added 'server 10.100.93.10 iburst prefer' pointing to node1
Restarted chronyd on node2 and verified it selects node1 as sole/best source (chronyc -n sources ^*), and node1 lists node2 as an NTP client (chronyc clients)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and chrony health baseline on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified chronyd active, config persisted, node1 resynced to public sources, and node2 continued tracking node1 throughout/after node1's restart

Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified chronyd active, config persisted, and node2 resumed tracking node1 (Reference ID 0A645D0A) with node1 showing node2 as an active client

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal time source (serves time, has local reference)
evidence.summary: node1 /etc/chrony.conf updated with allow 10.100.93.11/32 and local stratum 10, chronyd restarted active, firewalld ntp service opened, and node1 shown syncing its own upstream sources

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of a public server
evidence.summary: node2 chrony.conf changed to 'server 10.100.93.10 iburst prefer' (pool directive removed); chronyc -n sources on node2 shows '^* 10.100.93.10' as the sole selected source by IP

evidence.requirement: node1 actually serving node2 as an NTP client
evidence.summary: chronyc clients on node1 lists vm-rhel7-4277807675 (node2) as an active NTP client with recent Last poll

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: node1 boot_id e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 captured, chronyd active, sources synced pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect and restart occurred
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot scheduled in background (ack returned), subsequent execs on node1 time out / connection reset confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: node1 boot_id changed to 4c169d03-ab71-4787-b06e-733319db7ccb, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of services and cluster relationship
evidence.summary: chronyd active with persisted config after reboot, node1 resynced to a selected upstream source, and node2's sources output shows it kept/resumed tracking node1 (LastRx 33s) through the restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: node2 boot_id 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09 captured, chronyd active, tracking node1 pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect and restart occurred
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot scheduled in background (ack returned), subsequent execs on node2 time out / connection reset confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: node2 boot_id changed to 541128bd-5c93-4c21-a903-d5915b4e9523, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: post-restart recovery of services and cluster relationship
evidence.summary: chronyd active with persisted server directive after reboot; chronyc tracking shows Reference ID 0A645D0A (=10.100.93.10/node1); node1's client list shows node2 polling again post-restart
